testsuite.name: com.example.chatbar.desktop.DesktopFishPresentationTest

testcase.name: free preview UI requires explicit text and click and never selects a voice
management voice module matches appearance heading and remains operable in narrow layout
structured and avatar book fields display existing snapshot without auto query or binding
session UI preserves three state choice and language spaces during incremental editing
official sample UI plays only on explicit click without text TTS or binding
global UI exposes stale explicit model without fallback and changes remain draft
voice selector offers auxiliary only model by name and retains null follow session choice
picker real pointer query selects only explicit result with no preview
